verdict.rationale: A probe confirms GitLab Duo has documentation at a 'model_context_protocol/mcp_server' URL, suggesting some MCP integration exists within GitLab Duo, and GitLab markets AI-native agentic features (Duo agents automating tasks). However, the evidence pack gives no detail on whether this lets a user configure/plug in arbitrary external MCP servers for GitLab's agents to consume tools from, versus GitLab merely exposing its own MCP server to other clients. Missing for 10: concrete documentation/steps for adding external MCP servers as tool sources, independent/hands-on confirmation that GitLab Duo actually calls tools from user-configured MCP servers.
